plates._note: uploaded by hand at mapwarper.net (the API's base64 upload returns 500); map_id set so publish only re-fits. upload_file must stay the same image that was uploaded, so control points rescale correctly.
plates._registration: at_x/at_y are shifted +75 and +133 px from the printed ticks. The sheet's drawn content sits about 27 m east and 48 m north of its own grid annotation - the base map appears to have been mounted slightly off the printed frame. Measured by correlating the plate's road corridors against OSM at 8 windows across the sheet; the shift is constant, and with it applied the residual is -0.1 m east, +1.7 m north.
